label: Build a small room
prompt: Build a small cozy living room: floor, two walls, a sofa, a coffee table, a rug, a floor lamp and a plant. Real sizes, textured materials, warm lighting and a camera.

label: Product shot
prompt: Make a clean studio product shot of a ceramic coffee mug on a seamless backdrop, with soft three-point lighting and a 85 mm camera.

label: Low-poly landscape
prompt: Create a low-poly landscape: rolling ground, a few trees and rocks, a small cabin, and a sunset sky.

label: Critique my scene
prompt: Look at the scene (one multi-view look and a check) and list the 3 changes that would improve it most. Don't change anything yet.

label: Light this
prompt: Light the scene well for its content: set the world, add key/fill/rim lights as needed, and verify with one look.

label: Frame a camera
prompt: Add or move the scene camera for a flattering shot of {target}, check nothing is cut off, and show me.

label: Tidy up
prompt: Tidy the scene without changing how it looks: meaningful names, one collection per asset, parent loose parts, remove unused data.

label: Make 3 variations
prompt: Make 3 variations of {sel} next to it (different proportions, materials or details), each in its own collection.

label: Polish the render
prompt: Up to 3 rounds: render a quick preview you can see (render{preview:true,look:true,max:384}), fix the single biggest visual flaw, repeat.

label: Game-ready check
prompt: Run check{only:['game']} on {target}, explain the problems briefly and fix what can be fixed safely.
